verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a Bills API to create and manage vendor invoices (docs-5) and Transfers/Batch Transfers to pay vendors (docs-6, docs-7, docs-19), but the evidence shows no explicit approval workflow feature (e.g., multi-step sign-off, approval rules/thresholds) tying bill upload to payment release. Missing for 10: documented approval-workflow/authorization-chain feature for bills, evidence of a UI for uploading bills (only API-based), and independent confirmation the approval step exists before payout.
